h1: KPop Demon Hunters ratings: approval and average are different
description: {{title}} has IMDb {{imdb}} and {{rt}} on Rotten Tomatoes, so critics sit {{gapAbs}} points above audiences, with a Netflix Top 10 run of {{weeksInTop10}} weeks.
summary: KPop Demon Hunters records IMDb {{imdb}} and Rotten Tomatoes {{rt}} in this dataset. The critic percentage is noticeably higher than the audience average scaled by ten, a clear gap of {{gapAbs}} points. Positive-review share and average rating measure different things, so that difference cannot prove critics enjoyed it more. The OMDb snapshot is dated {{asOf}}.

sections.heading: What explains the KPop Demon Hunters numerical gap?
paragraphs: The arithmetic starts with the IMDb audience average of {{imdb}}, multiplied by ten to give {{imdbX10}}. Subtract that from the Rotten Tomatoes percentage of {{rt}} and the difference is {{gapAbs}} points. Critics score noticeably higher than audiences in this comparison, with a clear gap under the site's stated grouping rules.

However, the Metascore of {{metascore}} sits numerically nearer the scaled IMDb figure than the Rotten Tomatoes percentage. It does not provide evidence that the critic aggregates agree at the Tomatometer's level. One reading is that the share of reviews judged positive can exceed the typical strength of their approval, since percentages and average grades have different constructions.

IMDb lists {{votes}} votes in the source record. That count describes participation in that site's rating system; it is not a representative survey of everyone who watched. The {{genreCount}} {{genre}} films in this selected set have a median difference of {{genreMedianGap}}, placing the typical numerical relationship nearer zero than this film's.

None of those aggregates identifies a cause for individual reactions to the music, animation or story. For the definitions behind the calculation, see [how IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes measure ratings](/compare/imdb-vs-rotten-tomatoes).

sections.heading: Who is behind KPop Demon Hunters and how did it chart?
paragraphs: The premise follows a pop trio whose stage careers cover a second life fighting demons. The OMDb record names {{director}} and Maggie Kang as directors, and Arden Cho, May Hong and Ji-young Yoo among the lead cast. It lists a PG classification and a running time of {{runtime}}; those details belong to this dated database snapshot.

Netflix's chart data places it {{popularityRank}} among the {{setSize}} selected films by the hours rule used here. Its {{hours}} hours accumulate across {{weeksInTop10}} weeks in the global Top 10, with a peak rank of {{peakRank}}. This is viewing time within the recorded chart period, rather than a count of unique viewers or a lifetime total.

sections.heading: Which KPop Demon Hunters figure is useful for you?
paragraphs: If your question is whether critics tended to approve, the Tomatometer of {{rt}} answers it more directly. If you want the average mark from IMDb participants, use {{imdb}} instead. A reader who cares about the intensity of critical praise should keep the Metascore of {{metascore}} separate from the positive-review percentage.

For anyone choosing an animated action and adventure film, those genre labels, the listed cast and the PG classification supply context beyond the scores. The numbers cannot predict how someone will respond to its music or premise. Before deciding for children, check the relevant content guidance rather than treating popularity or a critic percentage as age advice.

sections.heading: What can the KPop Demon Hunters chart run tell you?
paragraphs: The {{weeksInTop10}} chart weeks show repeated appearances in the global Top 10, and {{hours}} hours quantify viewing within those appearances. That record establishes chart longevity under this dataset's method. It does not reveal how many individuals finished the film, how often they replayed it or whether the people voting on IMDb were the same viewers.

Popularity and ratings also have different collection dates and populations. A high placement can coexist with many possible patterns of response, so the Netflix rank cannot resolve the difference between the critic percentage and audience average. Read the dated score table for the measured figures and the hub for the chart cutoff.

faq.q: Are KPop Demon Hunters critics and audience ratings comparable?
faq.a: The IMDb average is {{imdb}}, while the Rotten Tomatoes critic percentage is {{rt}}. Scaling IMDb gives {{imdbX10}}, leaving {{gapAbs}} points with critics numerically higher. That is a clear gap in the table, but not evidence of a measured difference in enjoyment: one number averages ratings and the other counts positive reviews.

faq.q: How long did KPop Demon Hunters stay in Netflix's Top 10?
faq.a: The committed Netflix snapshot records {{weeksInTop10}} weeks in the global Top 10 and a peak rank of {{peakRank}}. The film ranks {{popularityRank}} among {{setSize}} selected titles by {{hours}} viewing hours accumulated across its chart weeks. That is a dated chart record, not its current streaming availability or a unique-viewer count.

faq.q: How many IMDb votes support the KPop Demon Hunters rating?
faq.a: The stored IMDb record has {{votes}} votes, shortened to {{votesShort}} in headline figures. They support the {{imdb}} average returned by OMDb at the snapshot date. The count alone does not show how representative those participants are, why they voted, or whether critics and viewers evaluated the same aspects of the film.
